# KuwaCSS v0 — complete reference
Include once: <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kuwacss@0/dist/kuwa.min.css">
No build step. No JavaScript. Plain semantic HTML already looks finished; add classes only to change layout or emphasis.

## Rules
1. A class is property-value. Values come from ONE scale: 0 xs s m l xl 2xl 3xl (text sizes also have 4xl).
2. A bare property means its medium value: padding = padding-m, gap = gap-m, margin = margin-m, rounded = rounded-m, shadow = shadow-m, border = 1px border.
3. Only the classes in this file exist. Never invent classes. These do NOT exist: p-4 mt-2 w-full flex items-center text-gray-500 hover:* dark:* btn container-fluid.
4. Responsive prefixes m: (>=768px) l: (>=1024px) xl: (>=1280px), mobile-first, ONLY on: hidden block stack row cols-1 cols-2 cols-3 cols-4 text-left text-center text-right order-first order-last grow.
5. Colours are roles: primary success warning danger info. Dark mode is automatic; force it with data-theme="dark" or "light" on any element.
6. Need something not listed? Write one line of CSS. Your CSS always beats KuwaCSS (cascade layers); never use !important.
7. Tune a primitive with an inline custom property: style="--gap: 2rem" or style="--min: 20rem".

## Layout (one per container)
stack          vertical flex column, children separated by gap (--gap, default m)
row            horizontal flex row, wraps, children vertically centred (--gap)
grid           responsive columns, as many as fit; --min sets minimum column width (default 16rem)
cols-1 cols-2 cols-3 cols-4 fixed column count (1 to 4); combine with m:/l:/xl:
container      centred content column, max 72rem, side padding
center         centres children horizontally and vertically
sidebar        first child is a fixed sidebar (--side, default 16rem), second child fills; stacks when narrow
sidebar-right  same as sidebar, the sidebar is the last child
cover          full viewport height; first child at top, last at bottom, middle centred; a single child is centred
switcher       row that becomes a stack below --threshold (default 30rem)
frame          fixed aspect ratio box (--ratio, default 16/9); img or video inside covers it
reel           horizontal scroll strip with snap
Children:  grow  shrink-0  span-2  span-3  span-full  order-first  order-last  self-start  self-center
self-end  self-stretch
Alignment: align-start  align-center  align-end  align-stretch  align-baseline  justify-start  justify-center
justify-end  justify-between  justify-around  justify-evenly  wrap  nowrap

## Spacing (sizes: 0 xs s m l xl 2xl 3xl; left/right follow writing direction)
padding-{size}  padding-x-{size}  padding-y-{size}  padding-top-{size}  padding-bottom-{size}
padding-left-{size}  padding-right-{size}  padding
margin-{size}  margin-auto  margin-x-{size}  margin-x-auto  margin-y-{size}  margin-y-auto
margin-top-{size}  margin-top-auto  margin-bottom-{size}  margin-bottom-auto  margin-left-{size}
margin-left-auto  margin-right-{size}  margin-right-auto  margin
gap-{size}  gap-x-{size}  gap-y-{size}  gap

## Text (text-* is size only, never colour)
text-xs  text-s  text-m  text-l  text-xl  text-2xl  text-3xl  text-4xl  text-left  text-center
text-right  font-sans  font-serif  font-mono  light  regular  medium  semibold  bold  italic
uppercase  lowercase  capitalize  underline  strike  tabular  truncate  lines-2  lines-3  balance
pretty  leading-tight  leading-normal  leading-loose  tracking-tight  tracking-normal  tracking-wide

## Colour (roles: primary success warning danger info; bg-{role} also sets a readable text colour; -soft is a light tint)
color-{role}  bg-{role}  bg-{role}-soft  border-{role}  color-text  color-muted  bg-page  bg-surface
bg-subtle  bg-transparent  opacity-0  opacity-25  opacity-50  opacity-75  opacity-100

## Box and size
border  border-top  border-bottom  border-left  border-right  border-0  rounded  rounded-0
rounded-s  rounded-l  rounded-xl  rounded-full  shadow  shadow-0  shadow-s  shadow-l  shadow-xl
width-full  width-auto  width-fit  width-screen  height-full  height-auto  height-screen
min-height-screen  min-width-0  max-width-s  max-width-m  max-width-l  max-width-xl  max-width-prose
max-width-full  max-width-none

## Display, position, interaction
hidden  block  inline  inline-block  visually-hidden  overflow-hidden  overflow-auto
overflow-visible  overflow-x-auto  overflow-y-auto  relative  absolute  fixed  sticky  static
inset-0  top-0  right-0  bottom-0  left-0  z-below  z-above  z-top  pointer  transition  select-none

## Components (these elements need no classes: button input select textarea label fieldset table dialog details nav blockquote code pre kbd mark hr progress figure img)
button         button look for <a> (a <button> needs no class)  (modifiers: primary ghost danger small large)
card           surface panel with border, radius, padding
badge          small label; add a role  (modifiers: primary danger success warning info)
alert          message box; add a role  (modifiers: primary danger success warning info)
prose          long-form text: measure, rhythm, headings, lists
switch         toggle switch on input[type=checkbox]
icon           1em icon in the current text colour on svg
label          wrap an input: label text sits above it; wrap a checkbox or radio: inline row

## Theme (override on :root)
--primary --success --warning --danger --info          any colour; oklch recommended
--text --muted --border --bg-page --bg-surface --bg-subtle   use light-dark(light, dark)
--font --font-serif --font-mono --radius --container --measure

## Examples
<header class="container row justify-between padding-y-m">
  <a href="/" class="bold text-l">Acme</a>
  <nav><a href="/docs">Docs</a><a href="/signup" class="button primary">Sign up</a></nav>
</header>

<section class="container stack gap-l padding-y-3xl text-center">
  <h1 class="text-4xl balance">Ship faster with less.</h1>
  <p class="text-l color-muted max-width-prose margin-x-auto">One stylesheet. No build. Looks right in light and dark.</p>
  <div class="row justify-center"><a href="/start" class="button primary large">Get started</a><a href="/docs" class="button ghost large">Read the docs</a></div>
</section>

<div class="grid gap-m" style="--min: 18rem">
  <article class="card stack gap-s"><span class="badge primary">New</span><h3>Fast</h3><p class="color-muted">Under 10 KB.</p></article>
  <article class="card stack gap-s"><h3>Simple</h3><p class="color-muted">150 words to learn.</p></article>
</div>

<div class="sidebar gap-l min-height-screen">
  <nav class="stack gap-xs padding-m bg-subtle"><a href="#">Overview</a><a href="#">Reports</a></nav>
  <main class="stack gap-l padding-l">
    <div class="row justify-between"><h2>Reports</h2><button class="primary">Export</button></div>
    <div class="alert success" role="status">Export finished.</div>
  </main>
</div>


# Cookbook: complete pages
Each pattern is a full page. Copy it, keep the link tag, change the content.

## Pattern: dashboard.html
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Dashboard</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kuwacss@0/dist/kuwa.min.css">
</head>
<body>
  <div class="sidebar gap-0 min-height-screen" style="--side: 15rem">
    <nav class="stack gap-xs padding-m bg-subtle" aria-label="Main">
      <a href="/" class="bold text-l padding-y-s">Acme</a>
      <a href="/dashboard" class="bold">Overview</a>
      <a href="/reports">Reports</a>
      <a href="/customers">Customers</a>
      <a href="/settings">Settings</a>
      <a href="/logout" class="margin-top-auto color-muted">Log out</a>
    </nav>

    <main class="stack gap-l padding-l">
      <header class="row justify-between">
        <div class="stack gap-xs"><h1 class="text-2xl">Overview</h1><p class="color-muted">Last 30 days</p></div>
        <div class="row gap-s"><button type="button">Export</button><button type="button" class="primary">New report</button></div>
      </header>

      <div class="alert info" role="status">Billing for October has been finalised.</div>

      <section class="grid gap-m" style="--min: 12rem" aria-label="Key metrics">
        <article class="card stack gap-xs"><span class="text-s color-muted">Revenue</span><span class="text-3xl bold tabular">$48.2k</span><span class="badge success">+12%</span></article>
        <article class="card stack gap-xs"><span class="text-s color-muted">Active users</span><span class="text-3xl bold tabular">8,431</span><span class="badge success">+4%</span></article>
        <article class="card stack gap-xs"><span class="text-s color-muted">Churn</span><span class="text-3xl bold tabular">1.8%</span><span class="badge warning">+0.3</span></article>
        <article class="card stack gap-xs"><span class="text-s color-muted">Open tickets</span><span class="text-3xl bold tabular">27</span><span class="badge danger">+9</span></article>
      </section>

      <section class="card stack gap-m">
        <div class="row justify-between"><h2 class="text-xl">Recent orders</h2><a href="/orders" class="text-s">View all</a></div>
        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
          <table>
            <thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Customer</th><th>Status</th><th class="text-right">Total</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr><td class="font-mono">#10492</td><td>Maria Alvarez</td><td><span class="badge success">Paid</span></td><td class="text-right tabular">$1,240.00</td></tr>
              <tr><td class="font-mono">#10491</td><td>Ken Watanabe</td><td><span class="badge warning">Pending</span></td><td class="text-right tabular">$310.50</td></tr>
              <tr><td class="font-mono">#10490</td><td>Priya Nair</td><td><span class="badge danger">Refunded</span></td><td class="text-right tabular">$89.00</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```

## Pattern: landing.html
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Acme — Ship faster</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kuwacss@0/dist/kuwa.min.css">
</head>
<body>
  <header class="container row justify-between padding-y-m">
    <a href="/" class="bold text-l">Acme</a>
    <nav>
      <a href="#features">Features</a>
      <a href="#pricing">Pricing</a>
      <a href="/login">Log in</a>
      <a href="/signup" class="button primary">Start free</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <main class="stack gap-3xl">
    <section class="container stack gap-l padding-y-3xl text-center">
      <span class="badge primary margin-x-auto">Now in public beta</span>
      <h1 class="text-4xl balance">Ship faster with less.</h1>
      <p class="text-l color-muted max-width-prose margin-x-auto pretty">One stylesheet, no build step, and a vocabulary your whole team and your AI tools already understand.</p>
      <div class="row justify-center gap-s">
        <a href="/signup" class="button primary large">Get started</a>
        <a href="/docs" class="button ghost large">Read the docs</a>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="features" class="container stack gap-l">
      <h2 class="text-center">Why teams switch</h2>
      <div class="grid gap-l" style="--min: 18rem">
        <article class="card stack gap-s"><h3>Zero build</h3><p class="color-muted">One link tag. Works in a static file, a CMS, or any framework.</p></article>
        <article class="card stack gap-s"><h3>Looks finished</h3><p class="color-muted">Plain semantic HTML is styled, accessible, and dark-mode ready.</p></article>
        <article class="card stack gap-s"><h3>AI friendly</h3><p class="color-muted">A 150-word vocabulary with a validator that checks generated markup.</p></article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="container switcher gap-xl align-center">
      <div class="frame rounded-l" style="--ratio: 4/3"><img src="https://picsum.photos/seed/kuwa/800/600" alt="Product screenshot"></div>
      <div class="stack gap-m">
        <h2>Layouts that just work</h2>
        <p class="color-muted">Name the layout you want: a stack, a row, a grid, a sidebar. Each one adapts to the space it has, so most pages never need a breakpoint.</p>
        <a href="/docs/layout" class="button width-fit">See the primitives</a>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="bg-primary padding-y-2xl">
      <div class="container stack gap-m text-center">
        <h2 class="text-3xl">Ready when you are</h2>
        <p class="text-l opacity-75">Free for individuals. Simple pricing for teams.</p>
        <a href="/signup" class="button large margin-x-auto">Create an account</a>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="container padding-y-l text-s color-muted border-top">
    <div class="row justify-between">
      <span>© 2026 Acme</span>
      <nav><a href="/privacy">Privacy</a><a href="/terms">Terms</a><a href="/status">Status</a></nav>
    </div>
  </footer>
</body>
</html>
```

## Pattern: settings-form.html
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Account settings</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kuwacss@0/dist/kuwa.min.css">
</head>
<body>
  <header class="container row justify-between padding-y-m">
    <a href="/" class="bold text-l">Acme</a>
    <nav><a href="/dashboard">Dashboard</a><a href="/settings" class="bold">Settings</a></nav>
  </header>

  <main class="container max-width-m stack gap-l padding-y-l">
    <div class="stack gap-xs"><h1 class="text-2xl">Account settings</h1><p class="color-muted">Changes save when you press Save.</p></div>

    <form class="stack gap-l" action="/settings" method="post">
      <section class="card stack gap-m">
        <h2 class="text-xl">Profile</h2>
        <div class="cols-1 m:cols-2 gap-m">
          <label>First name <input type="text" name="first" value="Maria" autocomplete="given-name"></label>
          <label>Last name <input type="text" name="last" value="Alvarez" autocomplete="family-name"></label>
        </div>
        <label>Email <input type="email" name="email" value="maria@example.com" autocomplete="email"></label>
        <label>Bio <textarea name="bio" placeholder="A sentence or two about you"></textarea></label>
        <label>Time zone
          <select name="tz"><option>UTC</option><option selected>Europe/Madrid</option><option>America/New_York</option></select>
        </label>
      </section>

      <section class="card stack gap-m">
        <h2 class="text-xl">Notifications</h2>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="switch" name="n-product" checked> Product updates</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="switch" name="n-billing" checked> Billing alerts</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" class="switch" name="n-digest"> Weekly digest</label>
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Delivery</legend>
          <label><input type="radio" name="delivery" value="email" checked> Email</label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="delivery" value="sms"> SMS</label>
        </fieldset>
      </section>

      <section class="card stack gap-m border-danger">
        <h2 class="text-xl color-danger">Danger zone</h2>
        <p class="color-muted">Deleting your account removes all data after 30 days.</p>
        <button type="button" class="danger width-fit">Delete account</button>
      </section>

      <div class="row justify-end gap-s">
        <a href="/dashboard" class="button ghost">Cancel</a>
        <button type="submit" class="primary">Save changes</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </main>
</body>
</html>
```

## Pattern: pricing.html
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Pricing</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kuwacss@0/dist/kuwa.min.css">
  <style>:root { --primary: oklch(55% 0.2 262); --radius: 0.75rem }</style>
</head>
<body>
  <header class="container row justify-between padding-y-m">
    <a href="/" class="bold text-l">Acme</a>
    <nav>
      <a href="/docs">Docs</a>
      <a href="/pricing" class="bold">Pricing</a>
      <a href="/login" class="button">Log in</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <main class="container stack gap-2xl padding-y-2xl">
    <section class="stack gap-s text-center max-width-prose margin-x-auto">
      <h1 class="text-4xl balance">Simple pricing</h1>
      <p class="text-l color-muted">Start free. Upgrade when the team grows.</p>
    </section>

    <section class="grid gap-l" style="--min: 18rem">
      <article class="card stack gap-m">
        <h3>Free</h3>
        <p class="text-3xl bold tabular">$0</p>
        <ul class="stack gap-xs color-muted"><li>1 project</li><li>Community support</li></ul>
        <a href="/signup" class="button margin-top-auto">Start free</a>
      </article>

      <article class="card stack gap-m border-primary shadow-l">
        <div class="row justify-between"><h3>Team</h3><span class="badge primary">Popular</span></div>
        <p class="text-3xl bold tabular">$12 <span class="text-s color-muted regular">per seat</span></p>
        <ul class="stack gap-xs color-muted"><li>Unlimited projects</li><li>Priority support</li><li>SSO</li></ul>
        <a href="/signup?plan=team" class="button primary margin-top-auto">Choose Team</a>
      </article>

      <article class="card stack gap-m">
        <h3>Enterprise</h3>
        <p class="text-3xl bold tabular">Custom</p>
        <ul class="stack gap-xs color-muted"><li>Dedicated support</li><li>Custom contracts</li></ul>
        <a href="/contact" class="button ghost margin-top-auto">Contact sales</a>
      </article>
    </section>

    <section class="switcher gap-l align-start">
      <div class="stack gap-s"><h2>Questions?</h2><p class="color-muted">Everything you need to know.</p></div>
      <div class="stack gap-s">
        <details><summary>Can I cancel any time?</summary><p>Yes. Cancel from settings; access continues to the end of the period.</p></details>
        <details><summary>Do you offer discounts?</summary><p>Yes, for education and non-profits.</p></details>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="container padding-y-l text-s color-muted border-top">
    <div class="row justify-between"><span>© Acme</span><nav><a href="/privacy">Privacy</a><a href="/terms">Terms</a></nav></div>
  </footer>
</body>
</html>
```
